body.statement: There is an algorithm which, from \(\mathfrak G\in\mathfrak E\) and \(m\in\mathbb N\), outputs a finite rational class \(\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\), one common core radius, a common recession fan refining every nonempty component \(P_{v,b}\) with all incidence maps and semantic projections, rational chart meshes, rational partitions of unity, and a computable number \(\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\downarrow0\) such that for every \(K\in\mathcal C_{\eta}\) there exists \(\widetilde K_m\in\mathfrak F_{\mathfrak G,m}\) whose semantic-label coverage is at least \(1-\eta-\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\), whose separated risk is at most \(R_r(K)+D\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\), and whose complete weighted ledger satisfies \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\le\Omega_{\mathfrak G}(m)\).
body.justification: This simultaneous incidence-diagram modulus is the theorem-level kernel; it turns pointwise chart approximation into a finite globally auditable search space.
body.gap: Burgos Gil and Sombra, Kastner, Shaw, and Winz, and Jones and Peet separately provide compatible geometry or Gaussian integration, but none controls a family of statistical rules simultaneously in Gaussian-weighted risk with an input-computable modulus.
body.consumer: The Job Corps ordered always-selected-complier workflow uses this modulus to search one common rule for the fixed assertions \(\underline\Delta(t;p)\ge0\), \(\overline\Delta(t;p)\le0\), and the lower- and upper-endpoint order comparisons over \(t<t'\), after encoding the observed cell vector, \((p_0,B)\), and \(\Sigma_0\) as \(\mathfrak G_0\).

obligation.what_is_open: Construct one nested chart family on the full recession-incidence poset whose weighted edge discrepancies, chart errors, tails, and weight variation vanish simultaneously with an input-computable modulus.
obligation.obstruction: The one-chart averaging estimate is conditional on a fixed chart and translation. Independently averaged incident charts need not agree on overlaps, while the weighted gluing inequality only charges the mismatch. No frozen primitive forces or constructs simultaneous compatible choices.
obligation.attempted: The prior Gaussian smoothing, covariance-orthogonal quotient, nested tangential boxes, common rational fan, and path telescoping arguments were retained. Their strongest common consequence is the fixed-library ledger, not a uniform incidence modulus.
obligation.partial_result: The established smoothing, one-chart averaging, and weighted-gluing inequalities give the respective uniform charges \(R_f\min\{1,s^2\sqrt{d/8}\}\), \(R_fk/(T\sqrt{2\pi})\), and \(\sum_e\Gamma_{C,e}^f+R_f\omega(h)/2\).  Hence every fixed chart and every fixed compatible finite library has an explicit ledger.  What is not proved is the existence of one incidence-compatible family whose edge discrepancies vanish simultaneously with an input-computable modulus.
